question.text: Per the SEBI (Mutual Funds) (Third Amendment) Regulations 2024 cited in NISM Ch 2.4.2.4, the newly-introduced Specialized Investment Fund (SIF) has a minimum investment ticket size of:

explanation.text: The Logic: The SIF minimum required investment is Rs. 10 lakhs from investors across all investment strategies. The Trap: Option A (INR 1 crore) is the AIF investor minimum; Option C (INR 25 lakh) matches the AIF employee/director minimum; Option D is not the SIF minimum either. Note: Source pages 40 and 98-99 of FINAL Series XIX-C AIF Managers (Dec 2025) workbook.
